artifact: BoxCars116k cloud-teacher Adapter recovery metrics for capability-retention plots

field_definitions.clean_reference_pct: Unadapted Edge MV-ViT-S accuracy on clean samples from the same protocol; pre-drift reference.
field_definitions.baseline_drift_pct: Unadapted Edge MV-ViT-S accuracy after the stated degradation.
field_definitions.adapter_recovered_pct: Edge MV-ViT-S with fixed cloud-unlabeled AdaptFormer under the stated degradation.
field_definitions.recovery_gain_pp: adapter_recovered_pct minus baseline_drift_pct, in percentage points.
field_definitions.retention_vs_clean_pct: Accuracy divided by clean_reference_pct times 100; recommended for the capability-retention y-axis.

scope.not_included_reason: This package is BoxCars-only. ModelNet40 has its own delivery package (modelnet40_recovery_metrics_20260809/).

recommended_for_jiehang_plot.why: Complete official test (12,322 tracks) paired evaluation; checkpoints were fixed before this evaluation and every drift CI excludes zero.
recommended_for_jiehang_plot.footnote: Full official make/test split (12,322 tracks) x 4 conditions x 2 models (Edge baseline, cloud-unlabeled Adapter); teacher omitted to keep the run about 7 minutes.

datasets.selection_boundary: No checkpoint, head, epoch, or loss weight was chosen from this test result.

models.adapter: Edge MV-ViT-S with fixed cloud-unlabeled AdaptFormer; cloud training used InternViT-6B task logits, visual features and clean anchor, without uploaded-sample labels

interpretation.meaning: The Adapter restores the frozen Edge model after camera drift. It does not run the 6B teacher at the edge. Positive recovery_gain_pp means recovery relative to the unadapted Edge baseline under the same degradation.
interpretation.main_observation: Full official test (12,322 tracks): sensor-noise recovery +7.33 pp, illumination +4.42 pp, motion-blur +1.94 pp, mean drift +4.56 pp; all paired-bootstrap 95% CIs exclude zero. Clean is essentially flat (+0.06 pp, CI [-0.20, +0.31]).
interpretation.do_not_claim: Do not merge the development validation curve into this official-test curve. All numbers here come from the same 12,322-track official test with checkpoints fixed in advance.
